newsitem.title: CHILE: Chilean stocks shoot up on fresh rate rumors.
newsitem.headline: Chilean stocks shoot up on fresh rate rumors.

text.p: Chilean stocks extended their New Year's rally on fresh rumors that the Central Bank planned to cut interest rates.
Central Bank sources told Reuters they knew of no imminent move on interest rates.
The IPSA index of the 40 most-traded shares soared 2.44 percent to 105.73 points in feverish trade, brokers said.

The gains added to a nearly three percent rise Friday on rumors the Central Bank was about to relax interest rates after months of tight credit policies, known popularly as the "ajuste," or adjustment.
